cover_prompt: Full-color illustration, warm cozy cottagecore aesthetic, premium quality. A cute kawaii sloth with big dreamy eyes and a gentle smile, wearing a soft knit sweater, lounging in a macrame hammock strung between two branches inside a sunlit treehouse. The sloth holds a steaming mug of herbal tea in one claw. On a small wooden shelf beside the hammock: a stack of pastel-covered books, a jar of honey with a wooden dipper, and a tiny potted succulent. Fairy lights are draped along the treehouse beams. Through the open window, a lush green canopy with birds and butterflies. Warm golden afternoon light bathes the scene in soft peach and amber tones. Cozy blanket draped over the hammock edge. Warm, serene, and inviting slow-living atmosphere. NO text in the image.
